body.body:
Enable the finite ordinary Parties package profile for Development Linux/x64. The trusted runner handoff binds the actual clean owner, selected tests, declarations, mapping and catalog before image probes. The complete topology uses the gateway plus seven pinned images; the generated reader verifies twelve public package binaries before owner metadata or factories.

Source: `338a6afc31850761f49c0de7d399266dd15cfe84`; [PR #22](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Platform/pull/22). The source selects published [Builds 4.44.2](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Builds/releases/tag/v4.44.2), SDK 4.0.4, Tenants 7.0.0, Memories 3.0.23 and Parties 3.0.0. The exact signed tool, source, inventory and catalog identities are recorded in `eng/builds-tuple.json`; the supported tool floor is 4.44.2.

Exact merged-source validation: [tuple preflight 41817311075](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Platform/actions/runs/41817311075) passed all 271 required cases with zero errors, failures, skips or unrun cases. The [four-SDK consumer matrix 41816978023](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Platform/actions/runs/41816978023) passed 60 activation/refusal cases and 208 finite evaluations. Parent audits checked 19,425 source hashes against immutable Git, all 317 signed tool archive members and 315 retained extracted bodies, unchanged test-output identities, and eight full reader baselines with twelve verified public binaries, 70 routes and 46 policies.

This is a Platform source/tag release. Probe doubles and source/component checks establish no live service readiness. Actual Parties native wire/persistence, same-job attachment, cancellation and cleanup qualification remain required after caller adoption. Existing independently qualified EventStore/Tenants runtime inputs remain valid. This release grants no candidate acceptance, whole-story acceptance or production deployment authority.
